sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def tops(fr):
    f=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    out=[]
    for c0 in (9,31,42,53):
        t=1
        while t<63 and f[t][c0]!='W': t+=1
        out.append(t)
    return tuple(out)
base=tops(current_frame)
print("base",base)
for c in (12,16,24,28,34,38,46,50):
    before=tops(current_frame)
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':57,'col':c}])
    after=tops(current_frame)
    print("click",c,"diff",[b-a for b,a in zip(after,before)] , after)
    if after!=before:
        # find revert among others
        for d in (12,16,24,28,34,38,46,50):
            if d==c: continue
            action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':57,'col':d}])
            if tops(current_frame)==before:
                print("  reverted by",d); break
        else:
            print("  NO REVERT FOUND, state",tops(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
